intent: Make the third kcov defect readable and bounded: list the individual lines the trace saw execute that kcov never listed as instrumentable, so a human can judge whether a subject's percentage covers its whole file, and record that this cannot inflate a number.
scope: meta/scripts/shell_coverage_report.py - off_set becomes a list of line numbers, not a count
python_pkg/tests/test_shell_coverage_report.py - assertions follow the new return type
docs/kcov-under-report.md - documents defect (c) and the nc_php.sh finding
Non-goal: fixing defect (c). kcov's line set cannot be repaired from outside kcov.
changes: _measure returns the sorted off-set line numbers instead of len(); main prints them like the uncovered list, because deciding whether a line is a statement needs the number, not a count.

Documented that an off-set line is BY CONSTRUCTION an executed line, so folding them in can only raise a percentage -- aw_autostart.sh 80/82 = 97.56% becomes 91/93 = 97.85%. The list cannot hide an untested statement.
Documented that nc_php.sh fails to measure on the PRE-FIX instrument too, so it is not a regression from the two-pass change.

verification.evidence: 80/82 = 97.56%, and the report now names lines 68, 70, 73, 79, 80, 81, 83, 84, 87, 88, 94. Reading them showed ordinary echo/local/if/cat statements; the trigger is the `{ ... } >>"$file"` command group at lines 61-65, after which kcov lists nothing in that function.

Off-set lines are dwm_config.sh:27 (`heal_config() {`), transcribe_deps.sh:9 (one-line function declaration) and clean_audio_filters.sh:197,200 (`((running++))`). All correctly not statements -- the benign class.

"kcov instrumented no lines" on the PRE-FIX instrument, identical to the current one. Confirms nc_php.sh is a pre-existing condition and the old 84/85 = 98.82% figure does not reproduce. Worktree removed afterwards.
29 passed; both modules hold 100% branch coverage (shell_coverage_report.py 62 stmts / 28 branches).
All hooks pass, no suppressions added.

risks: A subject with off-set lines is measured over a SUBSET of its statements, so its percentage is honest about that subset rather than the whole file. Mitigated by printing the lines so the gap is visible before a lib is cleared.
Defect (c) is not fixed and cannot be fixed from outside kcov; it is only bounded and made visible.
nc_php.sh currently yields no measurement at all, so it cannot be assessed for the allowlist until that is diagnosed separately.
rollback: git revert this commit; the previous behaviour (a count rather than a list) returns with no change to any percentage.
After rollback, re-run the two acceptance measurements (dot_resolver_install.sh 39/39, rpi_nc_ca.sh 73/73) to confirm the arithmetic is untouched.
